items.headline: The reviews are in — 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' opens Friday to raves
items.body: Tom Holland swings back into theaters Friday, and the critics have spoken: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is sitting around 91% on Rotten Tomatoes, with some reviewers calling it the best Spider-Man movie in over 20 years. It's a more grounded, grown-up chapter set four years after 'No Way Home,' with Zendaya, Sadie Sink and Jacob Batalon along for the ride — and it's tracking as one of the biggest openings of the entire year.
items.say: The new Spider-Man opens tomorrow and the reviews are actually great — people are calling it the best one in years, and it's tracking for one of the biggest openings of the year. You gonna go see it?

items.headline: Sonny steals the show — Son's two goals win the MLS All-Star Game
items.body: The MLS All-Star Game delivered in Charlotte on Wednesday night: LAFC's Son Heung-min scored twice in the span of three minutes — both teed up by New England playmaker Carles Gil — and busted out his signature 'camera' celebration on the way to MVP honors, as the MLS All-Stars edged a Liga MX All-Star squad 4-3. It's the second year running that MLS has beaten Mexico's best in the cross-border showcase.
items.say: Did you catch the MLS All-Star Game? Son Heung-min — the old Tottenham captain who plays in LA now — scored two goals in like three minutes and won MVP as MLS beat the Mexican league's all-stars. You follow any MLS?

items.headline: SummerSlam takes over Minneapolis — two huge nights this weekend
items.body: WWE's biggest summer show goes two nights this Saturday and Sunday at U.S. Bank Stadium, and the card is loaded: CM Punk defends the Undisputed WWE Title against Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns battles Seth Rollins for the World Heavyweight belt, and Brock Lesnar meets Oba Femi inside Hell in a Cell. It's also the first SummerSlam to stream on ESPN's app in the US — a genuine spectacle whether you're a diehard or just curious.
items.say: SummerSlam's this weekend — two whole nights in Minneapolis. CM Punk vs Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns, Brock Lesnar in a cage. Even if you're not big into wrestling it's a fun spectacle. You ever watch WWE?

items.headline: The dam's about to break — Skubal now expected to be dealt before Monday
items.body: Baseball's trade deadline hits Monday at 6pm ET, and the biggest name on the board looks like he's finally moving: after months of will-they-won't-they, the industry now expects the Tigers to trade two-time Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal, with the Dodgers seen as the favorite. The first dominoes are already falling — the Rangers grabbed catcher Logan O'Hoppe from the Angels — so the next few days should be pure chaos.
items.say: The baseball trade deadline's Monday and it sounds like the Tigers are finally gonna trade Skubal — the best pitcher in the league — probably to the Dodgers. When a guy like that moves it shakes up the whole season. You following the deadline?

items.headline: Going for three in a row — Haeran Ryu leads the final women's major
items.body: The AIG Women's Open — the last women's major of the year — teed off at Royal Lytham & St Annes in England, and Haeran Ryu grabbed the early lead with a 5-under 66. Here's the wild part: Ryu has won the last two majors (the KPMG Women's PGA and the Evian), so she's chasing a barely-believable third major in a row. World No. 1 Nelly Korda, in her group, scuffled to a 73.
items.say: There's a golf major on in England — the Women's Open — and this player Haeran Ryu is trying to win her THIRD major in a row, which almost never happens. She's leading after day one. Kind of an incredible run. You watch any golf?

items.headline: Shaboozey goes full Western — 'The Outlaw Cherie Lee' drops Friday
items.body: The 'A Bar Song (Tipsy)' star returns Friday with his fourth album, 'The Outlaw Cherie Lee & Other Western Tales' — and it's a proper concept record: a cinematic outlaw-revenge story with a doomed love at its center. If you liked his easygoing country-pop crossover, this is a bigger, more ambitious swing, all dusty saloons and open plains. Summer listening with an actual storyline.
items.say: Shaboozey — the 'A Bar Song' guy — has a new album out Friday, and it's this whole cinematic Wild West revenge story. Pretty cool concept for a country record. You into his stuff?

items.headline: Counter-Strike's Malta LAN is live — eight teams, trophy on Sunday
items.body: The CS2 summer stretch hits the big stage: the BLAST Bounty Summer LAN finals are underway now in Malta, with the eight best teams left — FaZe, MOUZ, Astralis, Spirit, Liquid and the rest — playing down to a champion this Sunday for a $740K pot. Quarterfinals are rolling this week (and it's the first event where the classic map Cache is back in the pool), so it's perfect have-it-on-in-the-background stuff.
items.say: Counter-Strike's got its big LAN finals going on in Malta right now — eight teams playing down to the trophy on Sunday. Good background watching if you're into CS. You keep up with it?

items.headline: The rock guys are back — Five Finger Death Punch drop 'Legacy' Friday
items.body: For the rock crowd: Five Finger Death Punch release 'Legacy' on Friday, their first album of all-new original material since 2022 — landing, fittingly, 19 years to the day after their debut. Lead single 'Eye of the Storm' already became their 18th No. 1 on Billboard's Mainstream Rock chart, so the metalheads in your life are eating well this weekend.
items.say: Five Finger Death Punch have a new album out Friday — first new stuff in a few years. If you've got a buddy who's into the heavier rock, it's a big one for them. You listen to any of that?
